description: This script modifies the database schema to include a new 'manager' role in the 'users' table's 'role' ENUM, enabling manager signups. It connects to the database, executes an ALTER TABLE statement, and handles possible errors such as the role already existing.

methods.name: addManagerRole()
methods.description: Asynchronously connects to the database and alters the 'users' table to include the 'manager' value in the 'role' ENUM. Handles errors and logs success or relevant messages.
